journal: Journal of Human-Centred Education, Learning and Assessment
principle: First-party scholarly publishing on the existing website mother database, with independently protected journal records, audited editorial roles and scalable private infrastructure.

platformStrategy.application: First-party modular PHP journal service with versioned role-based editorial workflow

plannedUpgrade.whenAvailable: Check actual disk quota, inode count, DB limit, PHP extensions, TLS, backup and privacy; never infer launch readiness from disk.

logicalZones.technologies: TLS, WAF, rate limits, CDN for anonymous immutable assets only
never: cache private sessions or review files

logicalZones.technologies: Existing site PHP application, verified site accounts, editor and reviewer RBAC, strong sessions, MFA for privileged actions

logicalZones.en: Journal tables in the unified mother database
logicalZones.technologies: Existing Bertina mother MariaDB with dedicated journal tables, foreign keys, scoped access and encrypted backups
never: create a second identity or financial source of truth

logicalZones.technologies: Private POSIX file service/volume outside every web root, restrictive permissions, antivirus, integrity hashes, tested restore
never: assume private cloud object storage is safe without a verified adapter
public CDN delivery of private files

logicalZones.technologies: Site-controlled idempotent job queue, scheduler, consented transactional SMTP and auditable notices
never: duplicate publishing/invoicing jobs on multiple nodes
send confidential submission content to analytics

logicalZones.technologies: First-party accessible article HTML/PDF, verified ISSN/DOI, Crossref registration after authorization, public preservation
never: release material prior to editorial acceptance

logicalZones.technologies: Future invoicing, waivers, reconciliation, refunds through legal payment service and minimal accepted-article interface
never: collect card data in the journal database

logicalZones.technologies: Redacted append-only operations/security event log, privacy-preserving aggregates, per-role viewing
never: log manuscript bodies, upload payloads or blind identities
treat absent integrations as zero activity

logicalZones.technologies: Encryption, distinct account/provider/location when possible, 3-2-1 practice, immutable backups and tested restore
never: store the only backup on same hosting filesystem

scaleStages.target: Existing hosting + planned 5 GB temporary increase
scaleStages.description: Use the current unified site and mother database. Permit preliminary intake only after verified TLS, author identity, private files and antivirus; formal review and publication require independent proof.
scaleStages.gate: Server security and full staging manuscript workflow audited

scaleStages.target: Dedicated scalable journal compute with one canonical mother data model
scaleStages.description: Scale the first-party journal runtime with secure private files, managed backups, observability and the same canonical site identity and data model.
scaleStages.gate: Observed reliability, backup restore, load/error measurements

scaleStages.description: Run multiple first-party application instances only after shared session state, safe file access, idempotent jobs, failover and database correctness are proven.
scaleStages.gate: Demonstrated multi-node correctness with same-document editing, job idempotency, restored backup and failover drills

scaleStages.description: Support multiple independently governed journals through tenant-scoped first-party modules, verified shared institutional identity and isolated editorial authority.
scaleStages.gate: Actual governance, staff, funding and audit capacity with no tenant data leakage

objectStorageCompatibility.privateUploadStorage: POSIX private filesystem outside web roots, with checksum, antivirus and access controls
objectStorageCompatibility.s3AllowedNow: encrypted backups and authorized public archive derivatives only

integrationBoundary.design: Versioned first-party API modules, immutable event IDs and unified account authorization
integrationBoundary.apiSource: Existing site API and journal-specific PHP modules backed by the canonical mother database
integrationBoundary.direction: Internal scoped journal services; never duplicate identities or payments

capacityPlanning.basis: Real observed throughput, file volume, seasonal submissions, retention and backup sizes

afterVerifiedLaunch.applicationUptimeTarget: 99.9% monthly aspiration, verify monitoring and support capacity
afterVerifiedLaunch.recoveryTimeObjective: <=24h initial target; <=4h after tested failover and documented operations

migrationGates: Inventory existing mother database journal tables, accounts, file paths, editorial roles and current public URLs
Prove destination PHP/MySQL compatibility, TLS, private files, SMTP and backup restore
Dry-run migration using sanitised/staging copies; negative-authorization and full review tests
Set safe cutover window and independent data freeze; snapshot consistent DB and private files
Restore destination and reconcile counts, file hashes, permissions and blinded reports
Verify canonical host, one-hop redirects only after true destination is functioning, canonical/hreflang, cache isolation
Permit writes on one origin only and monitor actual errors with rollback checkpoint
Record owner approval, rollback decision criteria and no split-brain reactivation
